findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_airport_info" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_airline_info" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_flight_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_passport, get_booking_status, get_eticket_pdf, cancel_booking · Private data: scan_passport, cancel_booking · Public sink: scan_passport, get_booking_status, get_eticket_pdf, cancel_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_passport, get_booking_status, get_eticket_pdf, cancel_booking · Private data: scan_passport, cancel_booking · Public sink: scan_passport, get_booking_status, get_eticket_pdf, cancel_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
